blocks.title: Solids
blocks.text: Solids are substances which are rigid and hard and have a definite shape and a definite volume.
The atoms, ions and molecules that make up a solid are closely packed and held together by strong cohesive forces; the constituent atoms, ions or molecules of a solid cannot move at random.

blocks.prompt: Contrast the motion of the particles in a solid with that in a liquid and a gas.
blocks.explanation: In a solid the particles are locked in place by strong cohesive forces and can only vibrate about fixed positions. In a liquid they stay in contact but move past each other at random, so the liquid flows. In a gas they fly freely through mostly empty space.

items: Solids are rigid and hard with definite shape and volume; their closely packed particles are held by strong cohesive forces and cannot move at random.
